segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to confirm the add-on seats for the analytics workspace and the timing you mentioned for the finance team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Right. We need 18 more seats, all standard users, not admins. We'd like them active by March 4 if possible.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. Your current agreement runs through September 30, so the 18 seats would be prorated from March 4 through that same end date. On the pricing sheet, that comes to $14,220 for the remainder of the term.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And that includes the same support level we have now?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, same business-hours support and the two admin training sessions. No change to the service terms.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. Finance asked if the invoice can reference cost center 4107 and our PO, which should be issued tomorrow.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, send me the PO when you have it. I’ll put cost center 4107 on the order form and the invoice request, and billing can issue against the PO.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Any setup fee for these seats?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No setup fee. Just the prorated seat cost. Once the order form is signed, we can enable the seats the same day, and your admin can assign them.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright, send the order form to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it matches what you just said, we should have it signed by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the March 4 start date, 18 standard seats, $14,220, and the September 30 co-term end date.
